message.text: I'm mapping out the auth flow: the frontend's authInterceptor handles access tokens and refresh tokens via cookies, while the backend's authenticator.go and v1 interceptors handle verification. I should double-check the auth-state module and backend package to confirm this.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && ls server/auth/ && echo "=== auth-state ===" && grep -n "localStorage\|sessionStorage\|export function\|export const" web/src/auth-state.ts | head -30

cd /bench/repo && grep -n "func (a \*Authenticator)\|func NewAuthenticator\|Bearer\|PAT\|pat_\|refreshToken\|RefreshToken" server/auth/authenticator.go | head -30; echo "=== extract.go ==="; grep -n "func \|Cookie\|Authorization" server/auth/extract.go | head -20
